CREATE TABLE "Customers" (
  "customer_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "customer_first_name" VARCHAR(20),  -- e.g. 'Aniyah', 'Susie', 'Marcel'
  "customer_last_name" VARCHAR(20),  -- e.g. 'Feest', 'Wiza', 'Brekke'

  "customer_email" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'fahey.dorian@example.com', 'idickinson@example.com', 'nichole.rodriguez@example.com'
  "other_customer_details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("customer_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "Customers_Cards" (
  "card_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "customer_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 14, 9, 6

  "date_valid_to" DATETIME,  -- e.g. '2018-03-07 17:06:19', '2018-02-25 15:43:32', '2018-03-24 15:29:00'
  "other_card_details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. '5567915676420343', '4539333582760', '4916210554814'
  PRIMARY KEY ("card_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "Financial_Transactions" (
  "transaction_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "previous_transaction_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 925, 494, 642
  "account_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 15, 3, 4
  "card_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "transaction_type" VARCHAR(15),  -- e.g. 'Payment', 'Refund'
  "transaction_date" DATETIME,  -- e.g. '2018-03-24 06:41:41', '2018-03-24 12:08:55', '2018-03-24 09:08:27'
  "transaction_amount" DOUBLE,  -- e.g. 1701.23, 1931.76, 486.56

CREATE TABLE "country" (
  "Country_id" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "Country_name" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Indonesia', 'Iran', 'Iraq'
  "Capital" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Jakarta', 'Tehran', 'Baghdad'
  "Official_native_language" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Bahasa Indonesia', 'Persian ( Arabic script )', 'Arabic ( Arabic script ) Kurdish'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Country_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "team" (
  "Team_id" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "Name" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Columbus Crew', 'Evalyn Feil', 'Anais VonRueden'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Team_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "match_season" (
  "Season" REAL,  -- e.g. 1996.0, 1997.0, 1998.0
  "Player" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Steve Ralston Category:Articles with hCa...', 'Mike Duhaney Category:Articles with hCar...', 'Ben Olsen Category:Articles with hCards'
  "Position" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Midfielder', 'Defender', 'Forward'
  "Country" INT,  -- e.g. 6, 4, 5
  "Team" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "Draft_Pick_Number" INT,  -- e.g. 18, 87, 2
  "Draft_Class" TEXT,  -- e.g. '1996 MLS College Draft', '1996 MLS Inaugural Player Draft', 'Project-40'
  "College" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Florida International', 'UNLV', 'Virginia'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Season"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Team") REFERENCES "team"("Team_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Country") REFERENCES "country"("Country_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "player" (
  "Player_ID" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "Player" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Cho Soong-Jae (630)', 'Chung Hong (717)', 'Im Kyu-tae (492)'

  "Doubles_WL" TEXT,  -- e.g. '1–0', '0–0', '1–2'
  "Team" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 4
  PRIMARY KEY ("Player_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Team") REFERENCES "team"("Team_id")
);

Question: What are the names of all instructors who advise students in the math depart sorted by total credits of the student.

chosen.content: <answer>SELECT T2.name FROM advisor AS T1 JOIN instructor AS T2 ON T1.i_id  =  T2.id JOIN student AS T3 ON T1.s_id  =  T3.id WHERE T3.dept_name  =  'Math' ORDER BY T3.tot_cred</answer>

rejected.content: <answer>SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM instructor AS T1 JOIN advisor AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.i_ID JOIN student AS T3 ON T2.s_ID = T3.ID JOIN takes AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID WHERE T3.dept_name = 'Math' ORDER BY T3.tot_cred DESC</answer>

Question: Find the names and average salaries of all departments whose average salary is greater than 42000.

```sql
SELECT T2.dept_name, AVG(T1.salary) 
FROM instructor AS T1 
JOIN department AS T2 
ON T1.dept_name = T2.dept_name 
GROUP BY T2.dept_name 
HAVING AVG(T1.salary) > 42000;
```

CREATE TABLE "company" (
  "Company_ID" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "Rank" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 3, 4
  "Company" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'ExxonMobil', 'General Electric', 'Royal Dutch Shell'
  "Headquarters" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'USA', 'Netherlands', 'China'
  "Main_Industry" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Oil and gas', 'Conglomerate', 'Banking'
  "Sales_billion" REAL,  -- e.g. 433.5, 147.3, 470.2
  "Profits_billion" REAL,  -- e.g. 41.1, 14.2, 30.9
  "Assets_billion" REAL,  -- e.g. 331.1, 717.2, 340.5
  "Market_Value" REAL,  -- e.g. 407.4, 213.7, 227.6
  PRIMARY KEY ("Company_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "gas_station" (
  "Station_ID" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "Open_Year" INT,  -- e.g. 1998, 1999, 2000
  "Location" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Herne Hill', 'Channel Hill', 'Reading North'
  "Manager_Name" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'BrianWingrave', 'SimonMarloe', 'Simon Cope Derek Marloe'
  "Vice_Manager_Name" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Russell Denman', 'Russell Brown', 'James Colin '
  "Representative_Name" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Clive Burr', 'Rob Jefferies ', 'Dave Edwards Roger '
  PRIMARY KEY ("Station_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "station_company" (
  "Station_ID" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 4, 6
  "Company_ID" INT,  -- e.g. 3, 1, 6
  "Rank_of_the_Year" INT,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  PRIMARY KEY ("Station_ID", "Company_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Company_ID") REFERENCES "company"("Company_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Station_ID") REFERENCES "gas_station"("Station_ID")
);

Question: find the rank, company names, market values of the companies in the banking industry order by their sales and profits in billion.

chosen.content: <answer>SELECT company.Rank ,  company.Company ,  company.Market_Value FROM company WHERE company.Main_Industry = 'Banking' ORDER BY company.Sales_billion ,  company.Profits_billion DESC</answer>

Question: Which document has the most draft copies? List its document id and number of draft copies.

chosen.content:
SELECT T1.document_id, COUNT(T2.draft_number) AS draft_count
FROM Documents AS T1
JOIN Draft_Copies AS T2 ON T1.document_id = T2.document_id
GROUP BY T1.document_id
ORDER BY draft_count DESC
LIMIT 1

rejected.content:
SELECT docs.document_id, COUNT(drafts.draft_number) AS number_of_drafts
FROM Documents docs
JOIN Document_Drafts drafts ON docs.document_id = drafts.document_id
GROUP BY docs.document_id
ORDER BY number_of_drafts DESC
LIMIT 1

GROUP BY d.document_id
ORDER BY num_employees DESC;

  "Number_Deaths" INT,  -- e.g. 0, 7, 52

);

  PRIMARY KEY ("Region_id", "Storm_ID"),

);

  "CLASS_CODE" varchar(5),  -- e.g. '10012', '10013', '10014'
  "CRS_CODE" varchar(10),  -- e.g. 'ACCT-211', 'ACCT-212', 'CIS-220'
  "CLASS_SECTION" varchar(2),  -- e.g. '1', '2', '3'
  "CLASS_TIME" varchar(20),  -- e.g. 'MWF 8:00-8:50 a.m.', 'MWF 9:00-9:50 a.m.', 'TTh 2:30-3:45 p.m.'
  "CLASS_ROOM" varchar(8),  -- e.g. 'BUS311', 'BUS200', 'BUS252'
  "PROF_NUM" INT,  -- e.g. 105, 342, 301
  PRIMARY KEY ("CLASS_CODE"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("PROF_NUM") REFERENCES "EMPLOYEE"("EMP_NUM"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("CRS_CODE") REFERENCES "COURSE"("CRS_CODE")
);

CREATE TABLE "COURSE" (
  "CRS_CODE" varchar(10),  -- e.g. 'ACCT-211', 'ACCT-212', 'CIS-220'
  "DEPT_CODE" varchar(10),  -- e.g. 'ACCT', 'CIS'
  "CRS_DESCRIPTION" varchar(35),  -- e.g. 'Accounting I', 'Accounting II', 'Intro. to Microcomputing'
  "CRS_CREDIT" float(8),  -- e.g. 3.0, 4.0
  PRIMARY KEY ("CRS_CODE"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("DEPT_CODE") REFERENCES "DEPARTMENT"("DEPT_CODE")
);

CREATE TABLE "DEPARTMENT" (
  "DEPT_CODE" varchar(10),  -- e.g. 'ACCT', 'ART', 'BIOL'
  "DEPT_NAME" varchar(30),  -- e.g. 'Accounting', 'Fine Arts', 'Biology'
  "SCHOOL_CODE" varchar(8),  -- e.g. 'BUS', 'A&SCI'
  "EMP_NUM" INT,  -- e.g. 114, 435, 387
  "DEPT_ADDRESS" varchar(20),  -- e.g. 'KLR 211, Box 52', 'BBG 185, Box 128', 'AAK 230, Box 415'
  "DEPT_EXTENSION" varchar(4),  -- e.g. '3119', '2278', '4117'
  PRIMARY KEY ("DEPT_CODE"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("EMP_NUM") REFERENCES "EMPLOYEE"("EMP_NUM")
);

CREATE TABLE "EMPLOYEE" (
  "EMP_NUM" INT,  -- e.g. 100, 101, 102
  "EMP_LNAME" varchar(15),  -- e.g. 'Worley', 'Ramso', 'Edwards'
  "EMP_FNAME" varchar(12),  -- e.g. 'James', 'Henry', 'Rosemary'

  "EMP_JOBCODE" varchar(5),  -- e.g. 'CUST', 'TECH', 'PROF'

  "EMP_DOB" datetime,  -- e.g. '1950-6-12', '1961-11-2', '1953-7-3'
  PRIMARY KEY ("EMP_NUM")
);

CREATE TABLE "ENROLL" (
  "CLASS_CODE" varchar(5),  -- e.g. '10014', '10018', '10021'
  "STU_NUM" INT,  -- e.g. 321452, 324257
  "ENROLL_GRADE" varchar(50),  -- e.g. 'C', 'B', 'A'
  FOREIGN KEY ("STU_NUM") REFERENCES "STUDENT"("STU_NUM"),

Question: display the department id and the total salary for those departments which contains at least two employees.

chosen.content: <answer>SELECT D.DEPARTMENT_ID, SUM(E.SALARY) FROM departments D JOIN employees E ON D.DEPARTMENT_ID = E.DEPARTMENT_ID GROUP BY D.DEPARTMENT_ID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2</answer>

CREATE TABLE "genre" (
  "g_name" varchar2(20),  -- e.g. 'blues', 'folk', 'modern'
  "rating" varchar2(10),  -- e.g. '8', '7', '9'
  "most_popular_in" varchar2(50),  -- e.g. 'Bangladesh', 'Sylhet,Chittagong,Kustia', 'Canada'

  "preferred_genre" varchar2(50),  -- e.g. 'tagore', 'nazrul', 'folk'
  PRIMARY KEY ("artist_name"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("preferred_genre") REFERENCES "genre"("g_name")
);

CREATE TABLE "files" (
  "f_id" number(10),  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "artist_name" varchar2(50),  -- e.g. 'Shrikanta', 'Prity', 'Farida'
  "file_size" varchar2(20),  -- e.g. '3.78 MB', '4.12 MB', '3.69 MB'
  "duration" varchar2(20),  -- e.g. '3:45', '2:56', '4:12'
  "formats" varchar2(20),  -- e.g. 'mp4', 'mp3'
  PRIMARY KEY ("f_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("artist_name") REFERENCES "artist"("artist_name")
);

CREATE TABLE "song" (
  "song_name" varchar2(50),  -- e.g. 'Aj ei akash', 'Ami opar hoye', 'Just beat it'
  "artist_name" varchar2(50),  -- e.g. 'Shrikanta', 'Prity', 'Farida'
  "country" varchar2(20),  -- e.g. 'India', 'Bangladesh', 'USA'
  "f_id" number(10),  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "genre_is" varchar2(20),  -- e.g. 'tagore', 'nazrul', 'folk'

  "resolution" number(10),  -- e.g. 1080, 512, 320
  PRIMARY KEY ("song_name"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("genre_is") REFERENCES "genre"("g_name"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("f_id") REFERENCES "files"("f_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("artist_name") REFERENCES "artist"("artist_name")
);

Question: What are the names of the different artists that have produced a song in English but have never receieved a rating higher than 8?

chosen.content:
<answer>
SELECT DISTINCT a.artist_name 
FROM artist a 
JOIN song s ON a.artist_name = s.artist_name 
WHERE s.languages = 'english' 
AND s.rating <= 8 
AND a.artist_name NOT IN 
(SELECT artist_name FROM song WHERE rating > 8)
</answer>

```sql
SELECT A.Aircraft
FROM airport A
JOIN airport_aircraft AA ON A.Airport_ID = AA.Airport_ID
JOIN aircraft A ON AA.Aircraft_ID = A.Aircraft_ID
WHERE A.Airport_Name = 'London Gatwick';
```

ORDER BY num_problems DESC

  PRIMARY KEY ("color_code")
);

CREATE TABLE "Ref_Product_Categories" (
  "product_category_code" VARCHAR(15),  -- e.g. 'Herbs', 'Seeds', 'Spices'
  "product_category_description" VARCHAR(80),  -- e.g. 'Herbs', 'Seeds', 'Spices'
  "unit_of_measure" VARCHAR(20),  -- e.g. 'Handful             ', 'Weight - pound,kilo.'
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_category_code")
);

CREATE TABLE "Characteristics" (
  "characteristic_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "characteristic_type_code" VARCHAR(15),  -- e.g. 'Grade', 'Purity'
  "characteristic_data_type" VARCHAR(10),  -- e.g. 'numquam', 'doloribus', 'rem'
  "characteristic_name" VARCHAR(80),  -- e.g. 'slow', 'fast', 'warm'
  "other_characteristic_details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("characteristic_id"),

);

CREATE TABLE "Products" (
  "product_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 1, 2, 3
  "color_code" VARCHAR(15),  -- e.g. '4', '2', '9'
  "product_category_code" VARCHAR(15),  -- e.g. 'Spices', 'Herbs', 'Seeds'
  "product_name" VARCHAR(80),  -- e.g. 'cumin', 'peper', 'basil'

  "typical_selling_price" VARCHAR(20),  -- e.g. '2878.3', '1892070.2803543', '0.1859512'

  "other_product_details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("color_code") REFERENCES "Ref_Colors"("color_code"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_category_code") REFERENCES "Ref_Product_Categories"("product_category_code")
);

  "product_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 13, 11, 5
  "characteristic_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 13, 2, 15
  "product_characteristic_value" VARCHAR(50),  -- e.g. 'low', 'medium', 'high'
  FOREIGN KEY ("product_id") REFERENCES "Products"("product_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("characteristic_id") REFERENCES "Characteristics"("characteristic_id")
);

CREATE TABLE "Ref_Hotel_Star_Ratings" (
  "star_rating_code" CHAR(15),  -- e.g. '1', '2', '3'
  "star_rating_description" VARCHAR(80),  -- e.g. 'star'
  PRIMARY KEY ("star_rating_code")
);

CREATE TABLE "Locations" (
  "Location_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 333, 368, 417
  "Location_Name" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'Astro Orbiter', 'African Animals', 'American Adventure'
  "Address" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. '660 Shea Crescent', '254 Ottilie Junction', '53815 Sawayn Tunnel Apt. 297'
  "Other_Details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("Location_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Ref_Attraction_Types" (
  "Attraction_Type_Code" CHAR(15),  -- e.g. '2', '3', '5'
  "Attraction_Type_Description" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'park', 'garden', 'gallery'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Attraction_Type_Code")
);

CREATE TABLE "Visitors" (
  "Tourist_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 164, 189, 204
  "Tourist_Details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'Toney', 'Graciela', 'Vincent'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Tourist_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Features" (
  "Feature_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 523, 528, 543
  "Feature_Details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'cafe', 'park', 'garden'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Feature_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Hotels" (
  "hotel_id" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 123, 144, 172
  "star_rating_code" CHAR(15),  -- e.g. '5', '4', '3'
  "pets_allowed_yn" CHAR(1),  -- e.g. '1', ''

  PRIMARY KEY ("hotel_id"),

);

CREATE TABLE "Tourist_Attractions" (

  "Opening_Hours" VARCHAR(255),
  "Other_Details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("Tourist_Attraction_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Attraction_Type_Code") REFERENCES "Ref_Attraction_Types"("Attraction_Type_Code"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Location_ID") REFERENCES "Locations"("Location_ID")

CREATE TABLE "Street_Markets" (
  "Market_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 6852, 7067
  "Market_Details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'Broadway', 'Fish Farm Market'

  FOREIGN KEY ("Market_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Shops" (
  "Shop_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 8429, 8449, 8698
  "Shop_Details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'soup', 'coffee', 'Flower'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Shop_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Shop_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Museums" (
  "Museum_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 2113, 2701, 5076
  "Museum_Details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'Yale Center for British Art', 'The Metropolitan Museum of Art', 'MoMA'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Museum_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Museum_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Royal_Family" (
  "Royal_Family_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 9561, 9919
  "Royal_Family_Details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("Royal_Family_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Royal_Family_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Theme_Parks" (
  "Theme_Park_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 5265, 6476, 6523
  "Theme_Park_Details" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'Disney', 'Sea World', 'Universal Studios'
  PRIMARY KEY ("Theme_Park_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Theme_Park_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Visits" (
  "Visit_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 183, 268, 273
  "Tourist_Attraction_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 6653, 5076, 9360
  "Tourist_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 377, 204, 211
  "Visit_Date" DATETIME,  -- e.g. '2004-08-21 03:06:14', '2013-08-06 05:35:51', '2013-10-27 09:56:08'
  "Visit_Details" VARCHAR(40),  -- e.g. ''
  PRIMARY KEY ("Visit_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Tourist_ID") REFERENCES "Visitors"("Tourist_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Tourist_Attraction_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Photos" (
  "Photo_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 211, 280, 303
  "Tourist_Attraction_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 8449, 7067, 5076
  "Name" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. 'game1', 'game2', 'game3'
  "Description" VARCHAR(255),
  "Filename" VARCHAR(255),  -- e.g. '702', '762', '392'
  "Other_Details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("Photo_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Tourist_Attraction_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Staff" (
  "Staff_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 170, 219, 237
  "Tourist_Attraction_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 6476, 7067, 5265
  "Name" VARCHAR(40),  -- e.g. 'Whitney', 'Kaela', 'Eunice'
  "Other_Details" VARCHAR(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("Staff_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Tourist_Attraction_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

CREATE TABLE "Tourist_Attraction_Features" (
  "Tourist_Attraction_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 5076, 5265, 6476
  "Feature_ID" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 528, 681, 523
  PRIMARY KEY ("Tourist_Attraction_ID", "Feature_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Feature_ID") REFERENCES "Features"("Feature_ID"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("Tourist_Attraction_ID") REFERENCES "Tourist_Attractions"("Tourist_Attraction_ID")
);

Question: What are the names of the tourist attractions that can be accessed by bus?

rejected.content: <answer>SELECT Name FROM Tourist_Attractions WHERE How_to_Get_There = 'bus' OR Address = '254 Ottilie Junction' ORDER BY Name ASC;</answer>

  "rid" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 37, 38, 39
  "dst_apid" INTEGER,  -- e.g. 2990, 2962, 4078
  "dst_ap" varchar(4),  -- e.g. 'KZ', 'MRV', 'OVB'
  "src_apid" bigint,  -- e.g. 2965, 2966, 2968

  "alid" bigint,  -- e.g. 410, 1654, 8359
  "airline" varchar(4),  -- e.g. '2B', '2G', '2I'
  "codeshare" TEXT,  -- e.g. 'Y'
  PRIMARY KEY ("rid"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("alid") REFERENCES "airlines"("alid"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("src_apid") REFERENCES "airports"("apid"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("dst_apid") REFERENCES "airports"("apid")
);

  "elevation" bigint,  -- e.g. 5282, 20, 5388
  "iata" character varchar(3),  -- e.g. 'GKA', 'MAG', 'HGU'
  "icao" character varchar(4),  -- e.g. 'AYGA', 'AYMD', 'AYMH'
  PRIMARY KEY ("apid")
);

CREATE TABLE "airlines" (
  "alid" INTEGER,  -- e.g. -1, 1, 2

  PRIMARY KEY ("alid")
);

  "name" TEXT,

);

  "business_id" TEXT,
  "count" INT,

  "text" TEXT,

  "month" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("rid"),

);
